what: Six iterations to green, above the protocols 1-5 typical band, every one a DISTINCT root cause in the harness and none a repeat after a fix — so continuation stayed correct rather than tripping Trigger 1. In order: (1) switchToDashboard matched the compact widget because Titlebar is shared and carries an identically-labelled Investigate control; (2) the dashboard boots visible:false and was never opened; (3) deterministic-L4 was never wired into the driver spawn env so the L4 path attempted real model inference and no incident formed; (4) the Investigate modal traps focus and occluded the later close press; (5) the widget-vs-dashboard exclusion keyed on the trace table, which exists only on /traces, so once an earlier stage navigated the dashboard to /logs the dashboard matched the widget filter; (6) openDashboard was called INSIDE pollUntil, re-pressing the toggle every 250ms for 30s and letting deadline parity decide whether the dashboard ended up open. Notably ZERO of the six were product defects.

The plans acceptance says the leg drives the path UNDER DETERMINISTIC-L4, and the matrix acceptance repeats it, but neither the plan nor research said HOW the mode reaches the app under test — which matters because the app is a GRANDCHILD process (xtask spawns node, node spawns tauri-driver, tauri-driver spawns the app), so the gate has to ride the driver spawn env rather than the callers shell. Fixed in-scope by setting ANDROMEDA_PULSE_L4_DETERMINISTIC in the tauri-driver spawn env. No spec change needed; recorded because the acceptance named a runtime condition with no owner for establishing it.
